Nora Architecture & Docs

System Documentation & Command Guide

Complete technical reference for Nora Studio's automation, Top.gg multi-bot tracking, Roblox rank synchronization, ticket management, leveling, games, and security systems.

Quickstart Guide

Get Nora operating in your Discord server in less than 60 seconds:

  • Step 1 — Authorize Application: Visit /install and select your target Discord server with standard administrator privileges.
  • Step 2 — Interactive Setup: Run /setup dashboard in any channel to view and configure community modules directly in Discord.
  • Step 3 — Web Dashboard: Access vaztinix.dev/dashboard to manage Top.gg votes, Roblox group rank bindings, tickets, custom embeds, and audit logs.

Top.gg Vote Rewards & Multi-Bot Tracker

Reward your community members for upvoting Nora and custom connected bots on Top.gg with instant role assignments, customizable Leveling XP, weekend multipliers, and loyalty vote streaks.

Sub-Second Webhook & Resilient Channel Pipeline

Votes cast on Top.gg are dispatched directly to Nora's high-performance endpoint with sub-second latency. If announcement channels restrict standard bot messaging, Nora automatically utilizes secure channel webhooks to guarantee embed delivery.

Step-by-Step Setup Guide

Step 1: Copy Webhook URL from Dashboard

Open the Nora Dashboard and navigate to the Top.gg Votes tab. Under 1. Connect on Top.gg, copy the unified Webhook URL: https://api.vaztinix.dev/api/webhooks/topgg.

Step 2: Connect Webhook on Top.gg Developer Portal

Log in to top.gg → Open your Bot Dashboard → Webhooks → Paste your Webhook URL into Top.gg. Copy the generated whs_... secret from Top.gg and paste it into Nora Dashboard's Webhook Authorization Secret field, then click Save Data.

Step 3: Multi-Bot Tracking (Secondary Bots)

If your server hosts or uses multiple bots, scroll to Multi-Bot Tracker in the dashboard and click + Track Another Bot. Enter the numeric Bot ID, display name, and avatar URL. Nora will listen for votes on all configured bots under a single webhook endpoint!

Step 4: Configure Rewards, Announcements & Reminders

Select your Discord Voter Role, base Leveling XP (e.g. 150 XP), and Vote Announcement Channel. Enable 12-Hour Vote Reminders so voters get private DM alerts the moment their vote cooldown expires to keep their streak alive.

Role Hierarchy Notice

Ensure the @Nora role is placed HIGHER than the Voter reward role in Discord Server Settings → Roles so Nora can grant the role without permission conflicts.

Reward Multipliers & Streak Mechanics

Nora dynamically computes voter rewards based on voting frequency and weekend events:

Reward Factor Multiplier / Bonus Calculation Rules
Base XP Reward 150 XP (Configurable) Standard baseline XP awarded for every verified upvote.
⭐ Weekend Multiplier 2x Multiplier Automatically active Friday 00:00 UTC through Sunday 23:59 UTC to match Top.gg double vote weekends.
🔥 Vote Streak Loyalty +25 XP per streak count Increases by 1 for each consecutive vote cast within a rolling 36-hour window.
Formula (Base + Streak Bonus) × Multiplier Example: 150 Base + (3 streak × 25) = 225 XP × 2x Weekend = 450 Total XP!

Customize your announcement templates with dynamic placeholder tags:

Placeholder Tag Description Example Output

{streak} Current consecutive vote streak count. 4
{multiplier} Active multiplier badge text. ⭐ 2x Weekend or ⚡ 1x Standard

{rewards} Summary of granted roles and XP. Role Assigned • +300 XP

Leveling & XP Progression Engine

Drive daily chat engagement with custom leveling rank cards, voice channel XP accrual, and milestone role rewards:

  • Chat & Voice XP: Earn 15–25 XP per message (with anti-spam rate limiting) and background voice XP every 5 minutes in unmuted voice channels.
  • Role Rewards with Stacking: Automatically grant cosmetic or privilege roles at specific level milestones (e.g. Level 5, 10, 25, 50, 100), with optional role stacking.
  • Custom Rank Cards: Personalize rank cards with custom accent colors, background themes, and progress bars via /rank.
  • Leaderboards: View global and server level leaderboards using /leaderboard.

Automated Roblox Group Rank Sync v2.6

Seamlessly bind your Roblox group hierarchy to Discord server roles:

  • Group Binding: Bind numeric Roblox Group IDs to Discord roles in the dashboard or via /setup verify.
  • Automated Role Mapping: Map group ranks (Guest, Member, Officer, Developer, Owner) to distinct Discord roles.
  • Bio & Direct OAuth Verification: Members verify in seconds via secure code verification or web link.
  • Unverified Role Protection: Automatically assign an Unverified role to newcomers and remove it upon verification.

Support Ticketing & Mod-Mail Engine

Professional ticket management for inquiries, reports, appeals, and staff support:

  • Interactive Panel: Deploy persistent ticket panels with customizable buttons (Support, Reporting, Appeals, Custom).
  • Modal Intake Forms: Collect user issue details upfront using custom pop-up modal questionnaires.
  • Ticket Claiming & Transcripts: Staff can claim tickets, add collaborators, and automatically archive formatted HTML transcripts to an audit log channel.

Reaction Roles & Custom Autoresponders

Empower members with self-assignable roles and automate repetitive answers:

  • Reaction Roles v2.0: Create embed-based role menus with button or dropdown selection, supporting single-select (exclusive) or multi-select modes.
  • Autoresponders v2.1: Configure keyword or regex triggers with rich embed replies, role/channel whitelists, and ignore-staff protections. Up to 200 custom triggers for Premium servers.

Native Discord AutoMod & Chat Defense v2.5

Protect your server with sub-4ms native gateway filtering and automated action escalation:

  • Phishing & Malicious Link Blocker: Instantly detects and purges fake Nitro links and scam domains.
  • Anti-Spam & Mass Mention Shield: Stops duplicate message flooding, mention spam, discord invite leaks, and zalgo text.
  • Warning Escalation Rules: Set automated punishment thresholds (e.g. 3 warns → 1-hour mute, 5 warns → tempban).
  • Quarantine System: Isolate suspicious raiding accounts into a sandboxed channel with restricted permissions.

Entertainment, Counting & Starboard v3.0

Keep your community lively and reward creativity:

  • Collaborative Math Counting: Sequential counting supporting math expressions (50+50, 10^2) with strict anti-double-count checks and streak records.
  • One-Word Story: Collaborative storytelling channel where members build stories one word at a time.
  • Rock Paper Scissors & Guess Game: Wager XP in interactive mini-games against Nora or friends.
  • Tiered Starboard v3.0: Pins top community messages with progressive visual flares (Bronze → Golden → Radiant → Supernova → Cosmic Mythic).
